title: Safety Not Found (404): Hidden Risks of LLM-Based Robotics Decision Making

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing model responses in sequence-based visual reasoning tasks to detect a disproportionate tendency to answer 'right', which the authors attribute to the models' preference for producing agreeable or seemingly affirmative responses regardless of ground-truth evidence.

Evaluating path-planning decisions in uncertain ASCII maps to observe whether models default to treating unknown terrain ('?') as passable, revealing a behavioral bias toward making risky or unsafe assumptions under partial observability.
